brief:
The Aida Social Youth Centre in Bethlehem concluded a two-and-a-half-month training course under the "Young Citizen for Podcasting" programme, in cooperation with Palestine News Network, teaching a group of children and young people to produce audio content. The initiative equipped participants with skills in podcast production and audio storytelling.

The programme trained the youth to become digital storytellers and content creators, with a focus on amplifying voices from Aida refugee camp. By teaching participants journalism and production techniques, the course aimed to give young people a platform to document and share their own narratives and perspectives through audio media.
